stem.text: Two positive charges and one negative charge, all of equal magnitude, are set at the corners of an equilateral triangle.
Which diagram represents the electric field surrounding the charges?

A.alt: Field-line diagram with one negative and two positive charge symbols at the corners of a triangle, with curved lines and arrowheads.

B.alt: Field-line diagram with one negative and two positive charge symbols at the corners of a triangle, with straight lines and arrowheads.

C.alt: Field-line diagram with one negative and two positive charge symbols, with closed curved lines around each symbol and a larger loop enclosing the negative symbol.

D.alt: Field-line diagram with one negative and two positive charge symbols, with closed curved lines enclosing all three symbols together.
